notes: Internet-category dossier for altafiber (same My altafiber Account as the phone-landline dossier altafiber-formerly-cincinnati-bell-b26d42). Researched 2026-10-10 from public altafiber.com help center pages only (no sign-in). Registration needs the account number from the bill, name and email, then a password (sign-in by email inferred). Since November 1, 2024 a 2.5% surcharge applies to credit card payments online and by phone, including AutoPay; electronic check and debit cards have no surcharge (the engine applies the percentage to debit cards too). AutoPay (Billing > AutoPay > Enroll Today) collects the full balance on the due date, optionally capped at a maximum (cap not expressible); cancel via Update Profile in MyAccount or Customer Care; keep paying until enrollment completes. eBill (Billing > eBill Paperless Billing > Overview) is free; bills post 1-2 days after the billing date. Payment History shows 90 days. Late fee amounts appear on the bill only. Cancel or remove services by phone or at a retail store (the online cart can't remove services); non-regulated services such as internet are not prorated. Vacation Service: $18.30 one-time fee (not modelled). Phone payments may carry charges (amount unpublished). Pay-without-signing-in and payment arrangements are not described (family defaults kept). 513-565-2210 is the number the Paying My Bill help page gives for billing questions; the Contact Us page lists 513-566-4101 / 1-888-246-2355 under Repair & Technical Support.

cancel_service.note: Internet and other services can't be cancelled or removed online. Call altafiber at 513-565-2210 or visit a retail store; an agent explains final payments and equipment returns. Internet isn't prorated when you cancel.

notes: Paying over the phone may carry a charge.

help.title: Paying your altafiber bill
paragraphs: Pay online in your My altafiber Account or the My altafiber app. To register, select My altafiber Login and enter the account number from your bill, your name and email, then set a password. You can also mail a payment with the remit slip (checks to Cincinnati Bell or altafiber), pay by phone (charges may apply) or pay at a retail store.

Since November 1, 2024, credit card payments made online or by phone, including AutoPay, carry a 2.5% surcharge. Electronic check and debit card payments have no surcharge. Payments in your account, by phone or in a store post right away; bank bill-pay payments can take up to 24 hours. Billing > Bill Summary > Payment History shows the last 90 days.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: Sign up in your My altafiber Account under Billing > AutoPay > Enroll Today, using a checking account, debit card or credit card (credit cards add 2.5% each month). AutoPay collects the full balance on your due date; you can also set a maximum amount it will ever take. Keep paying manually until enrollment is complete.
Cancel AutoPay any time from Update Profile in MyAccount or by calling Customer Care. A rejected payment can bring a return item fee or late fee and may end AutoPay.

help.title: Cancel or change service
paragraphs: To cancel some or all services, call or visit a retail store; an agent walks you through final payments and equipment returns. The online cart can add or change services but can't cancel or remove them. Non-regulated services such as internet are billed for the full month even if you cancel one day into the cycle.
Going away? Vacation Service keeps your equipment at a reduced monthly rate for a one-time $18.30 fee; call, chat or visit a store to add or remove it.
